description: Scatter of two groups of black circles told apart only by fill: filled (3 months) and open (12 months), with vertical and horizontal error bars and caps, a dashed reference line at y = 25, overlapping filled/open pairs near x = 52 and 61, markers against the x axis, legend samples in a box. Journal figure ('Graph.png'), 809x665 PNG. Marker centres measured by circle fits to the outer edge along rays clear of the error bars (radius 8.46 px; the overlapping pairs and the marker beside a cap at x = 32.8 fitted with that radius fixed), +/- ~0.5 px. Positions are image pixels, origin top-left.

xAxis.notes: Inward ticks on the bottom and top frame lines; major every 10 Gy (labelled 0-70), minor every 5.

yAxis.notes: Inward ticks on the left and right frame lines every 10 (labelled 0-120); y = 0 is the x axis.

pitfalls: Every marker is joined to its error bars, caps and (near x = 20) the dashed reference line: one blob per marker group.
Filled and open markers share colour and size; the open ones have white insides that hide the bars.
Near x = 52 and x = 61 a filled and an open marker overlap; the filled one at x = 52 is half hidden by the open one's white inside. The markers at x = 52-61 touch the x axis.
The legend box holds one sample of each marker beside its label: not data.
